direct_answer: Aker BP states that it does not have a climate change mitigation transition plan in line with ESRS requirements because it has no targets to reduce Scope 3 emissions; consequently, it also states it does not have a timeline for if or when it will develop such a plan. [Source 1] Therefore, the company does not disclose that a transition plan is aligned with limiting global warming to 1.5°C. [Source 1] Separately, Aker BP discloses that its climate-related targets are not science-based. [Source 6]
compliance_rationale: ESRS E1-1 requires disclosure of a transition plan and, if absent, a timeline for adopting one. Aker BP explicitly discloses it does not have an ESRS-aligned climate transition plan and does not have a timeline to develop one. [Source 1] ESRS E1-1/E1-4 also require explaining 1.5°C compatibility/science-based nature of targets; Aker BP instead discloses its targets are not science-based and provides no statement that a transition plan is 1.5°C-aligned. [Source 6][Source 1]
disclosure_gaps: No ESRS-compliant climate change mitigation transition plan disclosed (E1-1). [Source 1]
No timeline for adopting an ESRS-compliant transition plan (E1-1.17). [Source 1]
No explanation of how the transition plan/targets are compatible with limiting warming to 1.5°C (E1-1.16(a)). [Source 1][Source 6]

No disclosure that GHG reduction targets are science-based/1.5°C-compatible, nor framework/methodology/scenarios used for target-setting, nor external assurance of targets (E1-4.34(e)); instead targets are stated as not science-based and not externally assured. [Source 6]
key_findings: Aker BP states it has no Scope 3 reduction targets and therefore does not have a climate transition plan in line with ESRS requirements. [Source 1]
Aker BP states it does not have a timeline for if or when it will develop an ESRS-aligned climate transition plan. [Source 1]
Aker BP states its climate-related targets are not science-based and are not externally assured. [Source 6]
